title: Same king, same parliament?
hook: The same king stays on. Does that mean the same parliament continues?

knows: A monarch and a legislature are different institutions.
doesNotKnow: Distinguish a legislature created in 1922 from the united parliament specified in 1800, without inferring unrestricted sovereignty.

misconception: Yes, the king determines the parliament
objective: Distinguish a legislature created in 1922 from the united parliament specified in 1800, without inferring unrestricted sovereignty.
